name: d_strong
description: HYPOTHETICAL strong two-robot run, about nine objectives in 120 s: Botguy to the platform, Big Duck swapped into Botguy's start, Mystery Red Pom alone on the platform, both cups flipped upright (on tape, bonus only), 2 pickleballs under the platform, the 4 visible reds sorted into zone 3, ducks one-each in zones 2/3/4 (3x) plus a 4th duck under the platform. No rings. Not a measurement; a plausible target for a top team once both robots are reliable.
